name: weekly-focus
description: A side pane with today's tasks (Todoist, or a local tasks.md) and this week's priorities from a markdown file. Tick a task to complete it, with a 15-second undo.

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: Absolute path of the folder holding your notes. Empty uses the folder Claude Code was started in.

weeklyPriorities.title: Weekly priorities file
weeklyPriorities.description: Markdown file with the week's P1-P5 priorities, relative to the workspace.

tasksFile.title: Tasks file
tasksFile.description: Markdown task list used when Todoist is not connected, relative to the workspace.

todoistServer.title: Todoist MCP server
todoistServer.description: Name of the Todoist MCP server as /mcp lists it. Empty always uses the tasks file.

journalFolder.title: Daily notes folder
journalFolder.description: Folder inside the workspace where daily notes live, as <folder>/YYYY/MM-Month/DD-MM-YYYY.md.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: An IANA time zone such as America/New_York, used to decide what 'today' is. Empty uses this computer's local time.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts. Off, open it with /weekly-focus.
